q.songTitle: Stuck Inside of Mobile with the Memphis Blues Again
stanza: Now the senator came down here
To the wedding of his son
And me, I nearly got busted
And wouldn't it be my luck
To get caught without a ticket
And be discovered beneath a truck

partner.line: Now the senator came down here

q.line: Sure enough, I sent the plane tickets
q.linePrev: And I don't know if I'll be back again
q.lineNext: But when she came to kick it, things became different
